label: 2JZ-GE VVT-i
layout: Inline six, DOHC, 24 valves, belt-driven camshafts

notEquivalentTo.reason: Different intake camshaft pulley and oil-control hardware. Timing references and procedure pages differ.
Different accessory layout, timing covers and procedures. Belt-drive similarity is not evidence of identical parts.

notEquivalentTo.variant: 2JZ-GE VVT-i in other chassis (e.g. IS300, SC300, Aristo, Crown)
notEquivalentTo.reason: Accessory brackets, cooling and intake routing are chassis specific. Requires its own configuration record.

frame.origin: Crankshaft axis at the front (timing-end) face of the cylinder block

axes.x: Engine left (driver side in the LHD installation)
axes.y: Up, parallel to the cylinder bores
axes.z: Forward, along the crankshaft toward the timing drive

frame.handedness: Right-handed, matching glTF. Blender authoring uses X = engine left, Z = up, -Y = forward; the glTF exporter converts it.
frame.installationNotes: Installed inclination, mount positions and body clearances are not modeled.
